scope: Scoped UI playtest observations and owner feedback; not a blind fun verdict, natural-cadence playtest, all-menu acceptance or current-game balance rating.

methods: root private-GPU read-only Home visual/interaction review
independent private-GPU actual Home/Watch route checks

observations.feedback: ui: mobile top bar takes too much vertical space
observations.measured: Home header102CSSpx at320/400normal,148px at200%; Watch102px at both text sizes. Resource numbers14→28px; Settings44x44.
observations.visualReview: Root inspected400normal and320double: identity/settings have their own row, all resource amounts remain visible and text wraps at double size. More of the town is visible above the hero panel.
observations.interpretation: Deliberate rows remove unstable wrapping and the build inscription consumes no phone height. This supports the specific compact-header request.
observations.confidence: High for tested fixture/layouts; no claim about every long name or very large balance.
revalidateWhen: Header contents, identity, captions, breakpoints or font rules change
Before claiming compactness for a different viewport, multihero name or much larger balance

observations.origin: independent agent observation and pixel measurements
observations.status: original defect preserved; scoped repair verified

freshnessPolicy: These notes describe the pinned version and context. Preserve historical observations; inspect relevant changes and re-play affected moments before reusing their conclusions. No arbitrary calendar TTL substitutes for revalidation.
